text:
[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part V · Suits Relating to Immovable Property
 Section: 63::
]


By a mortgagee—
(a)for foreclosure;
Period of limitationThirty years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the money secured by the mortgage becomes due.
(b)for possession of immovable property mortgaged.
Period of limitationTwelve years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the mortgagee becomes entitled to possession.
